mapper.insert: insert into res_proxy_node_traffic (node_id, stat_time, rx_delta, tx_delta) values (#{nodeId}, #{statTime}, #{rxDelta}, #{txDelta})
mapper.select: select ifnull(sum(rx_delta), 0) as totalRx, ifnull(sum(tx_delta), 0) as totalTx from res_proxy_node_traffic where node_id = #{nodeId}
select ifnull(sum(t.rx_delta), 0) as totalRx, ifnull(sum(t.tx_delta), 0) as totalTx from res_proxy_node_traffic t inner join res_proxy_node p on t.node_id = p.id where p.instance_id = #{instanceId}

select p.instance_id as instanceId, ifnull(sum(t.rx_delta), 0) as totalRx, ifnull(sum(t.tx_delta), 0) as totalTx from res_proxy_node p left join res_proxy_node_traffic t on t.node_id = p.id where p.instance_id in #{instanceId} group by p.instance_id
